about.title: Our senior managers come from a seafaring background in ship management and operation.
text: Our senior management team is from a seafaring background and has worked extensively in ship management and operation. That lets us understand a client's needs, and our approach is focused on the client and the vessel, not merely on profit.
Our mission is to earn owners' appreciation on every job through diligence, hard work and dedication, improving efficiency and eliminating wasteful expenses.
We have a team in different time zones around the world, and we aim to be the name in ship agency across the Americas.
